Can ChatGPT find your business? 🤖

45% of consumers now use ChatGPT or other AI tools for local business recommendations (BrightLocal, 2026). In a study of 2,00,000+ local AI searches, business websites were the top source AI cited, followed by Google Business Profiles (BrightLocal, Sep 2026).

Five fixes: a website that says it plainly, a complete Google profile, reviews that name the service, the same details everywhere, and an FAQ with real answers.

Ask ChatGPT for "the best [your service] in [your city]" today. Are you in the answer?

Original content wins on Instagram now 🎬

On 17 November 2026, Instagram announced content protection, a tool that finds unauthorised reposts of creators' Reels. Accounts that keep reposting other people's content get pushed out of recommendations.

Shoot your own. Stop reposting. Label AI content. Export clean, without another app's watermark. And protect your originals if you're eligible.

Your shop, your team and your process are content nobody else can make.
